title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR DE SOFTWARE SENIOR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência profissional na especialidade técnica de atuação.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA na área de atuação e/ou em processos de Engenharia de Software.


Atividades:

  • Codificação, design de componentes, testes unitários, construção de aplicações, implementação e manutenção de software em busca de alta qualidade na aplicação de técnicas, normas e procedimentos atualizados de codificação e construção de software.
  • Desenvolver recursos e capacidades para usuários finais através de plataformas e ferramentas de desenvolvimento ou aprendizado de máquina, escrevendo código de qualidade com clareza e testabilidade de acordo com padrões e práticas de arquitetura, design implementação e segurança.
  • Configurar e personaliza software.
  • Investigar e propor soluções para problemas de desenvolvimento e design.
  • Conduzir análises para determinar necessidades de integração, projetar e planejar integrações.
  • Desenvolver blocos de construção de software reutilizáveis para permitir uma entrega mais rápida.
  • Participar do trabalho de estimativa e previsão de trabalho.
  • Melhorar o desempenho do software existente, diagnosticando e resolvendo problemas críticos.
  • Preparar documentação técnica.
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento de modelos de aprendizado de máquina e pipelines de dados.
  • Apoiar gerencialmente a execução e fiscalização de contratos de TIC na sua área de especialidade.
  • Apoia equipes multidisciplinares com mindset ágil;

Atuação Presencial

Vale Alimentação/Refeição

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em Salesforce Service Cloud

Implementação e evolução de Apex

Implementação e utilização de Platform Events

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows

Configuração e evolução de Omnichannel

Implementação de Bots

Participação nas cerimônias do squad em ambiente ágil (Scrum / Kanban)

Versionamento de código utilizando Git / GitHub

Integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins

Interação com áreas de negócio para entendimento das demandas

Contribuição com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código

Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento Salesforce

Domínio de Apex

Experiência com Platform Events

Experiência com Flows

Experiência com Omnichannel

Conhecimento em Git / GitHub

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)

Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal

Interesse em compreender o contexto de negócio além do desenvolvimento técnico


Formato de trabalho: Home office

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR DE SOFTWARE SENIOR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência profissional na especialidade técnica de atuação.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA na área de atuação e/ou em processos de Engenharia de Software.


Atividades:

  • Codificação, design de componentes, testes unitários, construção de aplicações, implementação e manutenção de software em busca de alta qualidade na aplicação de técnicas, normas e procedimentos atualizados de codificação e construção de software.
  • Desenvolver recursos e capacidades para usuários finais através de plataformas e ferramentas de desenvolvimento ou aprendizado de máquina, escrevendo código de qualidade com clareza e testabilidade de acordo com padrões e práticas de arquitetura, design implementação e segurança.
  • Configurar e personaliza software.
  • Investigar e propor soluções para problemas de desenvolvimento e design.
  • Conduzir análises para determinar necessidades de integração, projetar e planejar integrações.
  • Desenvolver blocos de construção de software reutilizáveis para permitir uma entrega mais rápida.
  • Participar do trabalho de estimativa e previsão de trabalho.
  • Melhorar o desempenho do software existente, diagnosticando e resolvendo problemas críticos.
  • Preparar documentação técnica.
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento de modelos de aprendizado de máquina e pipelines de dados.
  • Apoiar gerencialmente a execução e fiscalização de contratos de TIC na sua área de especialidade.
  • Apoia equipes multidisciplinares com mindset ágil;

title: Back-end Engineer / Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title: Back-end Engineer / Platform Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Back-end / Platform Engineer to design and build scalable backend services and APIs. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and API development , along with experience working with cloud platforms and modern containerized environments.


Mandatory Skills

  • GraphQL
  • API Development (GraphQL & REST)
  • Node.js
  • TypeScript


Required Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or backend development
  • Strong experience building and maintaining APIs using GraphQL and REST
  • Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or OCI
  • Experience with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Proficiency in backend technologies such as Node.js, Java (Spring Boot), or Python


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data-driven APIs using GraphQL and REST
  • Build and optimize backend services interacting with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Design and manage GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API performance
  • Collaborate with data, product, and application teams to define data access patterns
  • Implement API security, versioning, and governance best practices
  • Deploy and manage services using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Work with AWS or OCI cloud services to build scalable and reliable systems
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance
  • Participate in architecture discussions and mentor junior engineers

title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos


Para mais informações, assista ao nosso video

Se você gosta de desafios e colaboração, essa vaga é para você!

title: Desenvolvedo(a) Fullstack Sênior - Angular e Java
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um/uma Desenvolvedo(a) Fullstack Sênior - Angular e Java para se juntar à nossa equipe na Builders. Quem ocupar essa posição terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais junto a grandes empresas, apoiado por uma equipe colaborativa de tecnologia, designers e gestores.


Se você é apaixonado por desenvolvimento frontend e deseja fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico onde suas habilidades serão valorizadas, queremos você em nosso time para ajudar a criar soluções inovadoras e impactantes!


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (8 ou superior);
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Angular (12 ou superior);
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas como MVC, MVVM, Flux e Hexagonal;
  • Experiência com Spring Framework, especialmente Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com modularização de aplicações;

title: Analista de Automação & IA Júnior/Pleno (Presencial)
description:
Quem somos

Somos um escritório de advocacia com atuação nacional e forte operação digital, atendendo milhares de clientes por mês.

Nosso crescimento é sustentado por automação, dados e inteligência artificial aplicada à operação real, integrando marketing, vendas e jurídico de forma estruturada e escalável. Aqui, IA não é discurso. É uma ferramenta diária de trabalho.


O que estamos buscando

Buscamos um profissional prático, executor, que já trabalhe com ferramentas modernas de automação e saiba conectar sistemas para fazer a operação rodar melhor, mais rápida e com menos erros.

Queremos alguém que saiba usar n8n, Make, Lovable, Cursor AI ou ferramentas similares na prática, tenha experiência com automação de CRM, utilize IA generativa para resolver problemas reais e que goste de testar, ajustar e otimizar fluxos.

Se você tem perfil “mão na massa”, é curioso(a), gosta de tecnologia aplicada e quer evoluir rápido, essa vaga é para você.


O desafio

Você atuará diretamente na construção, manutenção e otimização de automações ligadas à operação comercial e jurídica.

O foco não é desenvolver sistemas do zero, mas integrar, automatizar, estruturar fluxos e aplicar IA para ganho de escala e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades

Trabalhar com Lovable para construção de soluções rápidas e funcionais.

Automatizar processos dentro de CRM como Kommo ou similares.

Integrar sistemas via API REST e Webhooks em nível funcional.

Usar IA generativa como OpenAI e LLMs para classificação de leads, organização de dados e criação de mensagens automatizadas.

Monitorar automações, identificar falhas e corrigir rapidamente.

Propor melhorias com foco em escala, redução de erros e ganho de eficiência.


Requisitos

Experiência prática com n8n, Make, Lovable ou ferramentas similares.

Vivência com automação de CRM.

Entendimento funcional de APIs REST e Webhooks.

Conhecimento básico de banco de dados e SQL simples.

Perfil organizado, analítico e executor.

Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial em Brasília.


Diferenciais

Experiência com Lovable.

Vivência com Kommo, HubSpot ou Pipedrive.

Experiência com WhatsApp API.

Experiência aplicando IA em fluxos comerciais.

Noções básicas de lógica ou Node.js apenas para ajustes pontuais.


O que oferecemos

Remuneração de R$ 4.000,00 a R$ 7.000,00.

Reajuste após 3 meses conforme performance.

Aprendizado acelerado em IA aplicada a negócios reais.

Contato direto com decisões estratégicas.

Crescimento rápido para quem entrega.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (LLM & AI Integration)


As a Software Engineer specializing in LLM Integration, you’ll be responsible for owning our AI infrastructure, agentic workflows, and the integration of Large Language Models into our core product. You’ll design and implement end-to-end AI features that empower our users and internal teams to leverage generative intelligence. You will maintain a scalable production environment using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and ensure that model outputs are accurate, secure, and performant. This role is perfect for someone who combines traditional software engineering rigor with a passion for the evolving AI landscape.


What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure & LLM Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable services that interface with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground model responses in proprietary data.
  • Build and optimize backend APIs and microservices to support AI-driven features.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks to ensure output quality.
  • Document AI system architecture, model versioning, and integration patterns.

Product Integration & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define user-facing AI capabilities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions (e.g., automated support, intelligent search, or content generation).
  • Optimize model latency and token usage for cost-effective and snappy user experiences.
  • Support front-end teams in delivering seamless AI interactions.

Data Engineering for AI

  • Write and optimize SQL queries and vector database schemas (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
  • Implement data preprocessing and embedding pipelines to prepare unstructured data for LLM consumption.
  • Establish best practices for fine-tuning models or managing few-shot learning datasets.
  • Monitoring & AI Ops
  • Monitor LLM performance, \"hallucination\" rates, and API health proactively.
  • Implement guardrails, moderation layers, and validation processes for AI safety.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services and manage model deployments.
  • Stay updated on the latest research in NLP, LLM orchestration, and agentic frameworks.


What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Strong Python proficiency, specifically in building scalable backend systems and working with asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding techniques.
  • Proven ability to work with RESTful APIs and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade software features.


Key Skills

  • Problem Solver: Analytical thinker who can debug complex, non-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Communicator: Excellent skills for explaining technical AI constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-Starter: Ability to take ownership of the AI roadmap in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Commitment to software craftsmanship, code quality, and AI safety.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with LLM Evaluation tools (Ragas, TruLens, or LangSmith).
  • Experience with deployment orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Serverless functions).
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and libraries like Hugging Face transformers or peft.
  • Prior work in a startup environment where rapid prototyping and iteration are key.


Why Join Us?

You’ll play a critical role in defining our AI strategy from the ground up. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment where you’ll have the autonomy to choose the best tools for the job and make a massive impact on our product’s evolution. Your work will directly define how our customers interact with the next generation of intelligent software.

title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: DevOps  Sr.
description:
Fundada em 2016, a Celcoin é uma infratech pioneira no Brasil, especializada em oferecer infraestrutura de tecnologia financeira nas verticais de pagamentos, banking e crédito. Nosso propósito? Potencializar negócios e transformar o acesso aos serviços financeiros no país; para isso, conectamos mais de 600 clientes do setor financeiro e 6.000 empresas não financeiras a milhões de transações diárias.


Venha fazer parte de nossa equipe e contribuir com aquilo que você tem de melhor, enquanto aprende e cresce ao nosso lado.

Isso é Celcoin. The best service for growth.

Estamos com uma oportunidade para atuar no nosso time, que utiliza a tecnologia para levar serviços financeiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Cultura de Plataforma: Evoluir nosso ecossistema de ferramentas para que os times de desenvolvimento tenham autonomia (Internal Developer Platform).
  • Orquestração em Escala: Gerenciar e otimizar clusters Kubernetes complexos, garantindo performance e resiliência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Liderar a automação de provimento utilizando Terraform e garantir a consistência dos ambientes.
  • GitOps & CI/CD: Implementar e manter fluxos de entrega contínua modernos, priorizando a estratégia de GitOps .
  • DevSecOps: Integrar camadas de segurança (SAST/DAST) e gestão de vulnerabilidades diretamente no ciclo de vida do software.
  • Observabilidade: Estabelecer padrões de monitoramento, logs e tracing para garantir que tenhamos visibilidade total da saúde do negócio.
  • Cloud Híbrida: Atuar na governança e arquitetura em Azure e AWS , além de integração com ambientes On-Premises.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Domínio de Cloud: Experiência sólida em Azure (primário) e conhecimentos em AWS .
  • Orquestração: Experiência avançada com Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Automação: Experiência profunda com Terraform e linguagens de scripting (Python, Go ou Bash).
  • Cultura GitOps: Experiência prática com ferramentas como ArgoCD ou FluxCD.
  • Stack de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com o ecossistema GitLab, Nexus, Harbor e SonarQube.
  • Arquitetura: Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka/RabbitMQ) e bancos de dados escaláveis.

description:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. O QUE BUSCAMOS:

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:

Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.

By Day 90

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior JD Edwards E1 Developer (Brazil Localization & Integration Specialist)

About Allari

Position Overview


We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the \"plumbing\" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

Core Specialized Requirements

  • Localization & Trade Integration: Proven experience managing the interface between JDE and external Tax/Global Trade platforms.
  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.
  • Fiscal Logic : A deep functional understanding of Brazilian tax calculation (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS) and its impact on Procurement, Sales, and the General Ledger.
  • JDE Orchestrator : Advanced proficiency in building and troubleshooting Orchestrations (including Groovy scripting) for real-time external integrations.


Technical Skills & Experience

  • Core JDE Development: Expert-level mastery of RDA, FDA, BDA, TDA, and C BSFNs.
  • Integration Protocols: High comfort level with Business Services (BSSV), REST/SOAP APIs, and EDI/Flat File processing.
  • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a \"Technical-Functional Bridge,\" understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the \"connectors\" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).
  • English: Intermediate / Preferred. (We prioritize your technical-functional JDE expertise over absolute fluency).
  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.


Apply with your CV in English.

title: Tech Lead Fullstack- Node/React
description:

description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.


Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. • O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.

  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (TMG) is a global provider of IT services, consulting, and specialized staffing solutions, operating with a systematic and quality-driven approach for over 25 years. Our client, a fast-growing technology company specializing in freight audit and business analytics solutions, is seeking a Solutions Architect to lead the technical delivery and implementation of their platform for new and existing customers.

This role sits within the Operations organization and focuses primarily on client implementation and solution delivery rather than software development . Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Business, or a related field .

  • Experience with software release processes and SDLC .
  • Familiarity with freight rate, freight audit, or logistics technology platforms is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with the Atlassian Suite (Jira, Confluence) is preferred.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.


POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É PARA VOCÊ?

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.


Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:


• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta \"batendo\" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.
  • Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?
  • Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity ) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.
  • Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (LLM & AI Integration)


As a Software Engineer specializing in LLM Integration, you’ll be responsible for owning our AI infrastructure, agentic workflows, and the integration of Large Language Models into our core product. You’ll design and implement end-to-end AI features that empower our users and internal teams to leverage generative intelligence. You will maintain a scalable production environment using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and ensure that model outputs are accurate, secure, and performant. This role is perfect for someone who combines traditional software engineering rigor with a passion for the evolving AI landscape.


What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure & LLM Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable services that interface with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground model responses in proprietary data.
  • Build and optimize backend APIs and microservices to support AI-driven features.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks to ensure output quality.
  • Document AI system architecture, model versioning, and integration patterns.

Product Integration & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define user-facing AI capabilities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions (e.g., automated support, intelligent search, or content generation).
  • Optimize model latency and token usage for cost-effective and snappy user experiences.
  • Support front-end teams in delivering seamless AI interactions.

Data Engineering for AI

  • Write and optimize SQL queries and vector database schemas (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
  • Implement data preprocessing and embedding pipelines to prepare unstructured data for LLM consumption.
  • Establish best practices for fine-tuning models or managing few-shot learning datasets.
  • Monitoring & AI Ops
  • Monitor LLM performance, \"hallucination\" rates, and API health proactively.
  • Implement guardrails, moderation layers, and validation processes for AI safety.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services and manage model deployments.
  • Stay updated on the latest research in NLP, LLM orchestration, and agentic frameworks.


What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Strong Python proficiency, specifically in building scalable backend systems and working with asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding techniques.
  • Proven ability to work with RESTful APIs and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade software features.


Key Skills

  • Problem Solver: Analytical thinker who can debug complex, non-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Communicator: Excellent skills for explaining technical AI constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-Starter: Ability to take ownership of the AI roadmap in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Commitment to software craftsmanship, code quality, and AI safety.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with LLM Evaluation tools (Ragas, TruLens, or LangSmith).
  • Experience with deployment orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Serverless functions).
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and libraries like Hugging Face transformers or peft.
  • Prior work in a startup environment where rapid prototyping and iteration are key.


Why Join Us?

You’ll play a critical role in defining our AI strategy from the ground up. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment where you’ll have the autonomy to choose the best tools for the job and make a massive impact on our product’s evolution. Your work will directly define how our customers interact with the next generation of intelligent software.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | 100% Remoto
description:
O DESAFIO:

A cada ano, o setor de saúde perde bilhões por falhas no faturamento. Nós somos o elo perdido que resolve esse gap com IA. Estamos em plena expansão , com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.


POR QUE ESTA POSIÇÃO É PARA VOCÊ?

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.


Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico : da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:


• O Agora (Execução e Precisão):

  • Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.
  • Garantir precisão absoluta \"batendo\" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.
  • Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.


• O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):

  • Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais .
  • Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.
  • Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios , utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.
  • Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.
  • Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).
  • Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.
  • Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.
  • Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?
  • Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity ) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.
  • Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.
